description: Watch up to 25 printed links (QR codes on menus, short links on flyers, posters, packaging, cards). Checks each one now and then once a day, and records the whole redirect chain. A link is flagged when it dies (fails twice, 6 hours apart), lands somewhere new, lands on a QR or short-link vendor's 'deactivated' page or a parked domain, changes how it redirects, or its certificate expires within 14 days. Returns the first results, page_url (a result page to hand to the person; shareable) and manage_url (private: edit, re-check, delete). No key needed.

email.description: Optional address for alerts; nothing is sent to it until it is confirmed with a code on the result page.

label.description: Where it is printed, e.g. 'menu table card'.

name: watch_printed_links
title: Watch printed links
